filtered_corpus_comparison.scope: Every converted dev/test row with at least one reviewed restricted-short-stem gold headword, full native dictionary, exact ordered grouped lemma match; existing losses remain explicit.

training_source_conflict.reason: The original source annotation is retained unchanged. NIKL explicitly requires 내디뎠다 for this past inflection; the optional compatibility policy rejects the short-stem analysis.

validation.rust: Full locked offline all-features suite, five short-stem tests, pinned corpus regressions, clippy with warnings denied, and rustfmt passed.
validation.browser: Full browser and HTTP regression suite passed, including source-backed short-stem judgments and desktop/mobile coverage.
validation.nix: CLI and web packages built successfully, including Rust package tests. Inventory review is checked by the flake gate.
validation.packaged_runtime: All 223 policy judgments passed both dictionary filters against the native database; API/CLI/export parity, boundary controls, desktop/mobile rendering and no page errors passed.
validation.release_performance: Three interleaved release runs per version and filter over 179112 novel records: after medians 1.508s headword and 1.509s compatible, peak child RSS below 30 MiB. Small differences are not a statistical equivalence claim.

limitations: Independent Korean-language review remains pending. Source-backed policy cases are not a precision benchmark.

The optional compatible policy applies finite NIKL normative restrictions. Raw JSON and headword-only candidates remain unchanged; dictionary reading assessments may change. No lookup aliases, spelling repair or source rewrites are introduced.

Twelve exact KRDict entry identities carry the policy. The native inventory includes unrelated 굴다, 들까불다, 썰다, 일다 and 붓다 meanings; these are not rejected by headword similarity. The winnowing 까불다 entry is restricted while its act-up homonym remains.

Consonant-only stems reject vowel-initial canonical endings and normalized honorific 시. ㄹ short stems reject the 어 family and 었 while retaining valid (으) allomorphs. Only the first owned inflection boundary is checked, so 겠, a suffix, auxiliary or copula does not transfer later endings back onto the root.

KRDict written 건들어, 까불어 (winnow) and 서툴어 conflict with the normative sources and are tracked without modifying their entries. Untyped 머물러/서둘러 source forms have valid short-stem purpose readings; their 어 readings belong to separate long stems.

Ten earlier policy judgments retained 딛다/내딛다/잡숫다/뵙다/찾아뵙다 because their written irregular class was unknown. They now record explicit short-stem conflicts, with before/after judgments preserved. Their written regular/irregular profiles remain unknown.

Seven unchanged training gold groups survive filtering. A separate original 내딛었다 training group is retained raw and explicitly rejected by the normative filter; this is a documented source disagreement, not a corrected annotation.

All four frozen raw corpus reports remain byte-identical. Every converted dev/test row with a reviewed short-stem gold lemma is checked: 45 previously retained exact groups remain among 46 rows, without new losses.
No additional dictionary schema, entry cache payload or raw spelling-path metadata is needed. AttachmentRule adds ShortStemEnding; Rust exhaustive matches need the addition.

Source-listed shortened senses absent from the pinned dictionary, general long/short lookup relationships, other lexical paradigms and historical/dialectal forms require further evidence and remain outside this finite restriction policy.

lexical_control.review: All six novel changes remove only the unsupported inflection; the native lexical determiner remains.

release_performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
